findings.current: From what I had observed, he was stubborn and taciturn.
findings.defect: “Stubborn” gives Li Feng a negatively inflexible temperament, whereas 우직하다 describes him as steadfast, honest, and dependable.
findings.rationale: The following sentence explicitly says Li Feng is not inflexible, reinforcing that 우직하다 is praise for his steadfast character rather than stubbornness.
findings.replacement: From what I had observed, he was steadfast and taciturn.

findings.defect: The soldiers are voicing a loyalty salute, not announcing their presence or answering roll call.
findings.rationale: 충 is a clipped military acclamation meaning loyalty or allegiance, accompanying the soldiers’ formal salute to Li Feng.

findings.defect: This invents a physical object for Cheongpung to grab even though Li Feng has only offered to obtain armor later. The beat means Cheongpung immediately seizes on the offer.
findings.rationale: No armor is present in the scene; 덥석 figuratively depicts Cheongpung snapping up Li Feng’s offer before accepting it aloud.

findings.current: I’ll go, listen to whatever he wants to tell me, and share a few entertaining stories about my adventures.
findings.defect: The direction of speech is partly reversed: Taekyung expected to tell the prince stories the prince wanted to hear, not listen to something the prince wanted to tell him.
findings.rationale: 듣고 싶어 하는 modifies 무용담: the prince wants to hear the heroic tales, and Taekyung plans to tell them.
findings.replacement: I’ll go and tell him a few of the heroic tales he wants to hear. That was about all I had expected.
findings.source: 가서 적당히 듣고 싶어 하는 무용담이나 몇 개 들려줘야지. 딱 이 정도?

findings.current: That was a rumor the Jin Family of Taiyuan had spread publicly.
findings.defect: The translation omits 헛소문, which explicitly marks the family’s public story as false or nonsensical rather than merely a rumor.
findings.rationale: 헛소문 means a false or groundless rumor, while 대외적으로 means it was presented to outsiders or the public.
findings.replacement: That was a bogus rumor the Jin Family of Taiyuan had spread for public consumption.

findings.current: He had already learned basic etiquette. I lowered myself onto one knee so that our eyes were level.
findings.defect: The omitted subject is incorrectly assigned to Prince Shangshan. Taekyung is saying that he himself has learned the basic etiquette required before kneeling.
findings.rationale: The statement directly motivates Taekyung’s immediately following action, and the prince’s rude beckoning provides no basis for attributing this observation to him.
findings.replacement: I had at least learned the basics of etiquette by now. I lowered myself onto one knee so that our eyes were level.
findings.source: 이미 기본적인 예의는 배웠다. 나는 한쪽 무릎을 꿇어 주표와 시선을 맞췄다.

findings.defect: The blunt imperative loses the prince’s dignified, request-like phrasing and makes his voice harsher than the source.
findings.rationale: 부탁하마 is a stately request, not a curt command; its ceremonious wording is part of the joke when the object turns out to be an autograph.

summary: Several scene facts and character beats are altered, including two reversed or misassigned actions, an invented physical grab, and localized losses in characterization and register.
